crossRefs.note: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”
For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”
I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.
Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: While they talked and questioned together, Jesus himself came near, and went with them.
translations.bsb: And as they talked and deliberated, Jesus Himself came up and walked along with them.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, while they communed and questioned together, that Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.
